# Erdos.p358 — Erdős problem 358

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/358
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/358.lean`, theorem `erdos_358.variants.prime_set`, AMS 5 11).

When $A =\{a_1 < \cdots\}$ corresponds to the set of primes, it is conjectured that the
$\limsup$ of the number of representations $$n=\sum_{u\leq i\leq v}a_i$$ is infinite.

## Statement
atTop.limsup (fun n ↦ (f (Nat.nth Nat.Prime) n : ℕ∞)) = ⊤

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
